title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: letter of indemnity release terms by document type
content:
## Scope

Where originals cannot be presented, some Bills of Lading and Transport Documents types allow cargo to be released without originals against a letter of indemnity. This table gives, for every type, whether such a release is available, who must sign the letter, the bank guarantee backing it as a percentage of the declared cargo value (0 when no bank guarantee is required), the fee per release against a letter of indemnity, and the earliest such release in calendar days after discharge.

## Tier table

| Document type | Release against a letter of indemnity available | Who signs the letter | Bank guarantee (percent of declared cargo value) | Fee per release | Earliest release (calendar days after discharge) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | No | Not applicable | 0 | USD 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | No | Not applicable | 0 | USD 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Yes | The consignee | 0 | USD 150.00 | 1 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | The consignee with a bank countersignature | 200 | USD 200.00 | 3 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | The consignee with a bank countersignature | 200 | USD 200.00 | 3 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | No | Not applicable | 0 | USD 0.00 | 0 |

## Reading the table

- Three types offer the release: the AHL Straight, AHL Negotiable and AHL Combined Transport Bills of Lading.
- On the AHL Straight Bill of Lading the consignee signs alone and the guarantee percentage is 0, so no bank guarantee is required.
- On the AHL Negotiable and AHL Combined Transport Bills of Lading the letter carries a bank countersignature and the guarantee is 200 percent of the declared cargo value.

## Hypothetical guarantee illustration

The declared cargo value below is a hypothetical input, not a customer fact. For an AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading with a declared cargo value of USD 48,317.35, the bank guarantee is USD 48,317.35 multiplied by 200 percent, which is USD 96,634.70.

## Points of judgement

**Can an AHL Switch Bill of Lading be released against a letter of indemnity?** No; the setting is No.

**What does a release against a letter of indemnity cost on an AHL Straight Bill of Lading?** USD 150.00 per release, earliest 1 calendar day after discharge.
